hook: Why Xi met Trump at the airport
caption:
🤝 Xi met Trump at Shenzhen airport with a hug; Thursday brings first-ever Trump-Xi-Putin talks.
🚀 Iran and the US trade strikes in the Gulf; no damage reported, Qatar keeps mediating.
💻 Nvidia's board says Jensen Huang won't return, as revenue doubles to $115.8B.
🗳️ Mary Peltola wins Alaska; Democrats will hold 56 Senate seats from January.
🤖 A US audit got ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok to write attack plans; hearings ahead.
What do you expect from the three-way talks? 👇
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

Cover: Why Xi met Trump at the airport
📷 颐园居 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

1/5 Trump, Xi and Putin to meet (1st)
Xi greeted Trump at Shenzhen airport with a hug. On Thursday, they meet Putin for first-ever three-way talks.
📷 颐园居 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

2/5 US and Iran trade strikes (3rd)
Iran sent drones at a US base in Bahrain; US jets hit back. Third Iranian attack in five days, by a key oil route.
📷 NASA (Public domain) via wikimedia

3/5 Nvidia: Huang won't return (+103%)
Nvidia's board says ex-CEO Jensen Huang won't be reinstated. Quarterly revenue still more than doubled: $115.8 billion.
📷 Derrick Coetzee (User:Dcoetzee) (CC0) via wikimedia

4/5 Peltola wins Alaska Senate (56)
Democrat Mary Peltola beat Republican Senator Dan Sullivan. Democrats will hold 56 of 100 Senate seats from January.
📷 Ross Fowler from Sydney, Australia (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

5/5 Chatbots gave out attack plans (4)
US auditors got four big chatbots to write attack plans. A Senate committee now plans hearings on AI safety.
